invocations.name: Agonizing Blast
invocations.description: Choose one damaging known Warlock cantrip; add your Charisma modifier to its damage rolls. Repeatable only for a different eligible cantrip.

invocations.name: Armor of Shadows
invocations.description: Cast Mage Armor on yourself without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Ascendant Step
invocations.description: Cast Levitate on yourself without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Beast Speech
invocations.description: Cast Speak with Animals at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Beguiling Influence
invocations.description: Gain proficiency in Deception and Persuasion.

invocations.name: Bewitching Whispers
invocations.description: Cast Compulsion once using a Pact Magic slot, refreshing permission on a Long Rest.

invocations.name: Book of Ancient Secrets
invocations.description: Transcribe discovered additional Ritual spells up to half Warlock level rounded up; spend two hours and 50 gp per spell level. They are cast as rituals through the active book and do not supply ordinary spells known or another starter pair.

invocations.name: Chains of Carceri
invocations.description: Cast Hold Monster without slot or material components, but only on a Celestial, Fiend or Elemental. You may not attempt it on that same individual again until a Long Rest, including after a failed attempt.

invocations.name: Devil's Sight
invocations.description: See normally within 120 feet in Dim Light and Darkness, magical or nonmagical.

invocations.name: Devouring Blade
invocations.description: When attacking with your Pact weapon, make three attacks total instead of the intrinsic level-5 two, never three additional attacks.

invocations.name: Dreadful Word
invocations.description: Cast Confusion once using a Pact Magic slot, refreshing permission on a Long Rest.

invocations.name: Eldritch Mind
invocations.description: Gain Advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration.

invocations.name: Eldritch Sight
invocations.description: Cast Detect Magic at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Eldritch Smite
invocations.description: Once per turn on a Pact-weapon hit, expend an actual Pact Magic slot for (1 + expended slot level)d8 additional Force damage, and optionally knock a Huge-or-smaller target Prone.

invocations.name: Eldritch Spear
invocations.description: Choose one damaging known Warlock cantrip with range at least 10 feet; increase its range by 30 feet per Warlock level. Repeat only for distinct eligible cantrips.

invocations.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
invocations.description: You can read all writing.

invocations.name: Fiendish Vigor
invocations.description: Cast False Life on yourself without a slot; use its maximum temporary-hit-point die rather than rolling.

invocations.name: Gaze of Two Minds
invocations.description: Touch a willing creature as a Bonus Action to perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. Maintain as a Bonus Action on the same plane; when within 60 feet, cast spells as if occupying your space or the creature's space.

invocations.name: Gift of the Depths
invocations.description: Breathe underwater; gain Swim Speed equal to Speed. Cast Water Breathing without a slot once per Long Rest.

invocations.name: Gift of the Protectors
invocations.description: Book can hold up to max(1, Charisma modifier) willing names. When a named creature would reach 0 HP without instant death, it drops to 1 HP instead; one shared rescue per Long Rest.

invocations.name: Investment of the Chain Master
invocations.description: Use your Bonus Action to command the familiar's single allowed Attack action, instead of sacrificing an attack. Grant eligible 40-foot Fly or Swim Speed, switch some damage to Necrotic/Radiant, use Warlock save DCs, and give one damage instance Resistance by Reaction. Never double the commanded action.

invocations.name: Lessons of the First Ones
invocations.description: Gain one eligible 5.5e Origin feat. Repeatable for different feats.

invocations.name: Lifedrinker
invocations.description: Once per turn on a Pact-weapon hit, deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage. Optionally expend and roll one Hit Die to heal that roll plus Constitution modifier (minimum 1). No cumulative older Charisma damage rider.

invocations.name: Mask of Many Faces
invocations.description: Cast Disguise Self without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Master of Myriad Forms
invocations.description: Cast Alter Self without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Minions of Chaos
invocations.description: Cast Conjure Elemental once using a Pact Magic slot, refreshing permission on a Long Rest.

invocations.name: Mire the Mind
invocations.description: Cast Slow once using a Pact Magic slot, refreshing permission on a Long Rest.

invocations.name: Misty Visions
invocations.description: Cast Silent Image without a spell slot.

invocations.name: One with Shadows
invocations.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, cast Invisibility on yourself without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Otherworldly Leap
invocations.description: Cast Jump on yourself without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Repelling Blast
invocations.description: Choose a damaging known Warlock cantrip with an attack roll. On a hit, push a Large-or-smaller target up to 10 feet straight away. Repeatable for a different eligible cantrip.

invocations.name: Sculptor of Flesh
invocations.description: Cast Polymorph once using a Pact Magic slot, refreshing permission on a Long Rest.

invocations.name: Sign of Ill Omen
invocations.description: Cast Bestow Curse once using a Pact Magic slot, refreshing permission on a Long Rest.

invocations.name: Thief of Five Fates
invocations.description: Cast Bane once using a Pact Magic slot, refreshing permission on a Long Rest.

invocations.name: Visions of Distant Realms
invocations.description: Cast Arcane Eye without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Voice of the Chain Master
invocations.description: While your familiar is on the same plane, communicate telepathically, perceive through its senses and speak in your voice through it; the normal Find Familiar sensory action applies.

invocations.name: Whispers of the Grave
invocations.description: Cast Speak with Dead without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Witch Sight
invocations.description: Gain Truesight to a range of 30 feet.
